hero.title: Hi, I'm Vipul S Jain .
hero.lead: 3+ years designing, securing, and automating AWS environments, from VPC networking and IAM to zero-downtime deployments and database migration.

projects.title: AWS Blue/Green CI/CD Automation
projects.desc: Zero-downtime blue/green deployments with AWS CodeDeploy, fed by a GitLab CI → S3 artifact pipeline, on a mixed-instances Auto Scaling Group that blends Graviton and x86 across On-Demand and Spot.

projects.title: SES Email Analytics Pipeline
projects.desc: A serverless pipeline that captures Amazon SES events (sends, deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces) in near real time and makes them queryable with SQL. Provisioned with Terraform.

projects.title: Secure VPC Architecture
projects.desc: A production AWS environment in Terraform: a 6-subnet VPC with NAT, an ALB in front of EC2, RDS MySQL and EFS, all encrypted with KMS. Audited with CloudTrail, GuardDuty and AWS Config, with OpenVPN access and VPC peering.

projects.title: Zero-Downtime DB Migration
projects.desc: Migrated a production MongoDB workload to Amazon DocumentDB using AWS DMS, with full data validation and minimal downtime.

projects.title: More AWS projects
projects.desc: Hands-on infrastructure, automation, and security builds collected in one repository.

bullets: Architected secure, scalable AWS environments using EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.
Designed VPC architectures with public/private subnets, NAT gateways, and VPN connections.
Enforced security with IAM least-privilege roles, MFA, and WAF rules.
Reduced incident response time ~40% with CloudWatch dashboards and proactive alerting across 20+ resources.
Managed RDS and DocumentDB with automated backups and point-in-time recovery.
Migrated MongoDB to Amazon DocumentDB using AWS DMS with minimal-downtime replication and full data validation.
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD and AWS CodeDeploy for consistent, version-controlled releases on EC2.

paragraphs: I build reliable, secure, and automated infrastructure on Amazon Web Services . My day-to-day spans VPC architecture, IAM least-privilege security, database migration with AWS DMS, and CI/CD automation.

At KaHa Technologies I architect cloud environments, cut incident response time with proactive monitoring, and keep releases consistent and low-downtime. I care about reliability, automation, and getting the security work right the first time.
